FAQs
How long is the free trial?
The free trial of Standard or Essentials lasts for 14 days. For example, if you start your trial on August 29, your trial would end on September 12.
Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan during the free trial?
Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade at any time during your trial. If you upgrade to Premium, you’ll just pay the difference in price between the two plans for the remaining days of your free trial. Downgrades to your monthly or annual plan go into effect at the end of the monthly billing period. You won't receive a refund for previously billed charges, but you’ll retain access to those features until the end of the billing period.
What happens if I pause or cancel during the free trial?
If you cancel your subscription during the free trial, you won't be charged for any services. You can pause your subscription or delete your Mailchimp account at any time using the Settings tab in Account & Billing.
Will I get billing reminders before the free trial ends?
Mailchimp will send you reminders with upcoming billing estimates before your trial ends. When the free trial ends, you’ll be charged the then-current monthly or annual fee for the plan you selected.
How do I get access to SMS?
SMS marketing is available to Mailchimp users in select markets with a paid marketing plan. After you agree to the terms, submit an SMS Marketing application , and get approved, you can purchase SMS credits from the SMS overview page , the SMS settings page , the SMS editor, or through an email link sent to the primary email address associated with your Mailchimp account.
Learn more about SMS marketing
How do SMS credits work?
Credits are purchased in blocks as an add-on to a paid monthly or annual marketing plan. Credit blocks are automatically re-purchased each month on the account billing date. Unused credits will expire each month and do not roll over. You can add credits as your subscribed SMS audience grows or your sending frequency increases. You can also make a one-time purchase in the middle of a billing cycle if you run out of credits early and want to refill them before your credits renew.
Learn more about SMS marketing credits
Can I buy email credits instead of a monthly or annual marketing plan?
Yes. If you send emails infrequently and prefer to pay as you go, you can buy email credits as an alternative to a monthly or annual plan.
See how it works
How do I switch to a different plan?
You can switch to a new plan at any time by going to the Billing page in your account. Select the plan you’d like to switch to and immediately start using new features.
What payment methods do you offer?
We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and (in select countries) direct debit. We also support transactions in a range of currencies.
What happens if I hit the contact or sending limit?
After your Free Trial, if you hit your contact or sending limit, Mailchimp will automatically bill you for your overages. As long as you pay for your overages on time, we will not stop your campaigns or pause your account. In addition, if your audience size grows to (or email sends reach) the point where it would be more cost effective for you to be in a different contact tier during your Free Trial, Mailchimp may upgrade your contact tier so you are in a more economical tier when billing begins.
Do you have pricing for high-volume email senders?
We do indeed. If you have more than 200,000 contacts, we have a high-volume plan that can meet your needs.

FAQs
What are marketing tools?
Marketing tools are software that help businesses plan, launch, and measure their marketing efforts. They cover a wide range of functions, from sending emails and scheduling social posts to running paid ads, managing customer relationships, and tracking performance. Online marketing tools typically fall into a few main categories: email, social media, advertising, automation, analytics, CRM, and content creation. Businesses use digital marketing tools to save time, reach the right audience, and understand what's actually working. The most effective digital marketing strategies tend to use tools that connect these functions together, so your data and campaigns stay in sync instead of living in separate places.
What online marketing tools does Mailchimp offer?
Mailchimp is a full marketing platform , which means you get a wide range of tools in one place for various types of marketing . Here's what's included:
Email marketing and templates: Build and send campaigns using pre-built templates, drag-and-drop editing, and design tools that don't require any coding.
Social media and ads: Schedule organic social posts and run paid ads across Facebook, Instagram, and Google directly from your account.
Landing pages: Create standalone pages for campaigns, product launches, or lead capture — no separate tool needed.
Marketing automation: Set up automated flows based on customer behavior, like welcome series, purchase follow-ups, or win-back campaigns.
Signup forms and surveys: Grow your audience and collect zero-party data with embedded forms and customer surveys.
CRM, segmentation, and behavioral targeting: Organize your audience, group contacts by behavior or purchase history, and send more relevant messages.
Analytics and reporting: Track opens, clicks, revenue, and audience growth. Send time optimization helps you reach people when they're most likely to engage.
AI tools: Generate copy, get subject line suggestions, predict audience demographics, and get smart recommendations for your next campaign steps.
What marketing tools does Mailchimp offer for small businesses?
Mailchimp's free marketing features make it one of the more accessible marketing platforms for small businesses. You don't need a design team or a developer to get started — the platform is built so anyone can use it. Here's what you can do with Mailchimp’s marketing tools for small businesses:
Free plan with core tools: Email marketing, landing pages, signup forms, and basic automation are all available on the free plan.
No technical skills required: Everything is drag-and-drop, with templates and guided setup flows that walk you through the process.
All tools in one place: Instead of managing separate subscriptions for email, social, and analytics, everything lives in a single account.
Scales with your business: Paid plans add features like SMS marketing, advanced automation, A/B testing, predictive segmentation, custom domains, and priority support as you grow.
How do Mailchimp's marketing tools compare to using separate tools?
Many businesses start with a mix of separate tools — one for email, another for social, a third for analytics. It works, but it creates friction. Here's what's different about using an all-in-one marketing platform:
Everything is connected: Your audience data, campaigns, and reporting all live in one place, so you're always working from the same picture of your customers.
One login: No switching between platforms or trying to reconcile data from different dashboards.
Shared audience data across channels: Email, social, and ad campaigns all pull from the same contact lists and segments, so your targeting stays consistent.
No manual syncing: When someone joins your list, updates their preferences, or makes a purchase, that data is available across all your tools automatically.
Which Mailchimp marketing tools are free?
The free plan includes a solid set of tools for getting started. These features are available at no cost:
Email marketing up to 500 contacts: Send campaigns, use templates, and track basic performance metrics.
Basic automation flows: Set up simple triggered emails like welcome messages or birthday sends.
Landing pages and website builder: Build pages for campaigns or your business without a separate hosting service.
Signup forms: Collect email addresses from your website or social profiles.
Basic reporting: See opens, clicks, and unsubscribes to understand how your campaigns are performing.
Paid plans unlock SMS marketing, advanced automation, A/B testing, predictive segmentation, custom domains, and priority support.
What AI marketing tools does Mailchimp include?
Mailchimp has built AI tools into the platform to help you work faster and make smarter decisions. These include:
Generative AI for copy: Draft email content, subject lines, and other marketing copy directly in the editor.
Subject line helper: Get real-time feedback and suggestions as you write to improve open rates before you hit send.
Smart campaign recommendations: Mailchimp surfaces suggestions for your next steps based on your account activity and audience data.
Send time optimization: Automatically send campaigns when individual contacts are most likely to open them, based on their past engagement.
Predictive demographics: Get estimated age and gender data for your audience to help you build more personalized campaigns.
How do I get started with Mailchimp's marketing tools?
Getting started takes just a few minutes. Here's how to set things up:
Create a free account: Sign up at Mailchimp.com — no credit card required. You'll have access to free tools right away.
Connect your store, website, or app: Mailchimp integrates with platforms like Shopify, WooCommerce, and WordPress to pull in customer and purchase data automatically.
Build your audience: Import existing contacts or set up a signup form to start growing your list from scratch.
Create your first campaign: Choose a channel, and use a template to get your first send out the door.
Use onboarding support: Paid plans include onboarding assistance to help you get set up and make the most of the tools available to you.

Know More, Do More with Mailchimp
Get the most out of Mailchimp with our step-by-step videos and tutorials. Browse by topic or search by feature for 24/7 help with any stage of your business journey.
Search Help Center
Popular guides and tutorials
Know to Grow: Feature guide for smart marketing
Learn how to use our advanced marketing features to understand your customers, create compelling content, and grow your business.
Getting Started with Tags
Tags are labels you create to help organize your contacts in Mailchimp. Learn how to use tags, where to find them, and how to get started.
Requirements and Best Practices for Audiences
An audience of engaged contacts means more sales and a higher return on investment (ROI). Get tips and requirements for maintaining your Mailchimp audience.
Import Contacts to Mailchimp
Learn how to use our import tool to add or update contacts in Mailchimp.
About Mailchimp Pricing Plans
Whether you're starting out or already have a large number of contacts, we have a pricing option for you. Learn about Mailchimp's pricing plans, features, and add-ons.
About SMS Marketing with Mailchimp
Learn about the details of SMS Marketing with Mailchimp.
Quick start video tutorials
How to Create a New Audience for Smarter Growth

How to Organize Add, Remove, and Bulk Tag Contacts in 3 Simple Ways
▶ 4:37

Have more questions? Customers with paid plans can log in and email or chat with us.

Help by topic
Accounts
Set up your account, learn about billing, and stay up-to-date on compliance policies.
Audiences
Import contacts, create signup forms, and manage your Mailchimp audiences.
Automation
Automatically send purchase emails, welcome messages, and more.
Data Privacy
Find answers to commonly asked questions related to Mailchimp's privacy practices.
Edit and Design
Customize the content of your emails, landing pages, website, and other types of marketing in Mailchimp.
Email Delivery
Learn how we deliver email and how you can ensure contacts get your campaigns.
Emails
Use Mailchimp to build and send emails for your contacts.
Getting Started
Learn how to set up your account, import contacts, and create your first campaign.
Google Remarketing Ads
Reach potential customers all across the internet with Google remarketing ads.
Integrations
Connect Mailchimp with your e-commerce store and other apps.
Landing Pages
Create standalone web pages your audience can “land” on from emails, ads, or other digital locations.
Mailchimp & Co
Learn how to use the tools that help you manage your clients and the benefits of joining our partner program.
Merge Tags
Personalize your campaigns with contact names, social media buttons, blog posts, and more.
Mobile Apps
Learn how to use Mailchimp on tablets, smartphones, and other mobile devices.
Reports
Get performance stats for your marketing efforts and e-commerce store.
Templates
Use a prebuilt design or code your own templates for email campaigns.
Transactional Email
Send one-to-one e-commerce emails and automated transactional emails with Transactional Email’s delivery service.
Websites
Purchase a domain and create your own website with Mailchimp.
Get help from an expert
Need a hand with template design, using Mailchimp's advanced features, or general marketing strategy? Use our experts directory to find someone who can help you make things happen.
Browse the directory
Still have questions?
If you have a question about something that isn't covered here, check out our additional resources . And if that doesn't do the trick, you can send an inquiry through our contact form.
